title: Eternal Flame Physics Transmissions
author: Kelly Dillon
description:
Eternal Flame Physics Transmissions is an exploration of the structural nature of reality and the mechanics through which physical experience is generated.

Hosted by Elumenate Media founder Kelly Dillon, the podcast moves beneath the rendered surface of reality into the architecture that exists before events, perception, physical conditions, and lived experience become recognizable. Eternal Flame Physics examines structure, fields, pressure, pathways, trajectories, perception, the physical body, anomalous activity, time, continuity, environments, and the larger external architecture humanity is living within.

This is not New Age, spiritual, metaphysical, religious, or another belief system or paradigm. Eternal Flame Physics is anti-paradigm. It strips away mythology, symbolism, inherited explanations, and render-based interpretations in order to expose the mechanics underneath them. The experience is separated from the story built around it. The perception is separated from the structure producing it. The rendered event becomes evidence rather than the beginning of the explanation.

The work also maintains the foundational distinction between the Eternal and the external: the Eternal is original and unmoving; the external is movement-based architecture. Physical reality is render within that larger external condition, not the totality or source of reality itself.

Episodes move freely through the body of work rather than following a fixed syllabus. One subject, one question, one mechanic—and then the structure is followed wherever it leads.

No video. No visual performance. Just voice, Flame tone, and Eternal Flame Physics spoken in real time.

title: INVISIBLE LOSS | DNA Test, Secrets, Father, Who Am I, Acceptance, Intrusive Thoughts
author: latekiabush
description:
Have you ever discovered a truth that made you question everything about your life?

Have you ever felt like the ground beneath you shifted… but everyone around you kept saying, “nothing has changed”?

Do you find yourself asking:
 Who am I now?
 Where do I belong?
 Was any of it real?

Have you learned that the man who raised you is not your biological father… and now you’re carrying a kind of pain you don’t even have words for?

A quiet grief.
 An identity you can’t quite hold onto.
 A story that no longer fits.

And somehow… you’re still expected to cook dinner, answer texts, show up for your kids, and act like your entire identity didn’t just get flipped upside down.

(Meanwhile, inside… it’s giving fire, tornado, hailstorm, chaos, and who even am I all at the same time.)

If this is you—you’re not imagining it.
 And you’re definitely not alone.

This is Invisible Loss.

What you’re really wanting (even if you haven’t said it out loud):

You want to know the truth… fully.
 You want to feel acknowledged and accepted.
 You want to see yourself in someone—to finally recognize where you come from.
 You want to feel whole again.

And more than anything…

You want peace.
 Not perfect answers.
 Not a perfectly tied-up story.

Just… peace in your own mind and body again.

What you’ll find here:

This podcast is a space where your experience is finally named—and where you’re not told to “just move on.”

We talk about:

  • The emotional impact of DNA discoveries and hidden family truths
  • The loss of a father you still love
  • The weight of secrets, silence, and betrayal
  • Intrusive thoughts and identity confusion
  • Feeling like a stranger in your own life

But we also move toward something:

Here, you’ll learn how to:

  • Reclaim your identity—even when your story has changed
  • Process the grief that no one else sees
  • Quiet the mental spiral and intrusive thoughts
    • Find peace without needing every answer
    • Reconnect with yourself—your voice, your truth, your sense of belonging

    Because healing doesn’t come from pretending it didn’t happen…
     it comes from finally facing what was hidden—and choosing yourself anyway.

    I’m Latekia Bush — a mother and woman who once believed I knew exactly where I came from… until I didn’t.

    Like many of you, I discovered that the man who raised me was not my biological father. And in that moment, everything shifted. My identity, my past, how I saw myself—everything.

    I tried to move on like nothing changed.
     I searched for answers outside of myself.
     I wanted closure… clarity… something that would make it all make sense.

    But that didn’t bring me peace.

    What did?

    Allowing myself to feel the loss.
     To name what was true.
     To stop minimizing the pain just because others couldn’t see it.

    And then… something harder.

    I had to accept my reality.
     Not the version I wished it could be.
     Not the version that made it easier to hold onto what I thought I had…

    But the truth.

    And I had to let it go.

    Not like it didn’t matter—
     but in a way that stopped it from holding me hostage.

    Because peace didn’t come from figuring everything out.

    It came when I stopped fighting what was…
     and allowed myself to live forward anyway.

    And slowly…
     I began rebuilding who I am from the inside out.

    This podcast is for women—often mothers, often “Daddy’s girls”—who grew up believing they had a complete story… only to discover there was more.

    More truth.
     More questions.

description:
WTTN Presents: Tales of Suspense and Terror, transports listeners back to the golden age of radio drama. WTTN is a popular radio station in The City, providing news and entertainment to a wide audience. Recently, the station has changed management and the transition has been... odd. The station's regular cadre of actors - Chet, Dianne, Mary, Eddie, Herbie, and Sophia - have noticed that not everything is running as smoothly as before. Where did the writers go? Who is Richard, the new station manager and why does he seem to know so much about each of them? What are these other stations that have begun to bleed over into WTTN's frequency?


And the coffee in the break room? Well, the coffee is as terrible as ever. Some things never change.


Petit Guignol Productions is an entertainment company that creates original horror audio dramas. "Petit Guignol" comes from the "Grand Guignol," a French theater in the late 1800s and early 1900s that, in addition to bawdy comedies, staged gruesome and shocking plays often ripped from the sensationalist headlines of the day. PGP seeks to provide similar entertainment over the "air waves" of modern media.

title: This Is Your Season

description:
There is a season for everything — and whatever season you are living through, you don't have to walk it alone.
This Is Your Season is a daily contemplative podcast from SageWork, guided by Dr. Christopher "Doc" Hershey and Sarah Jane. Each week the show enters one season of the human heart — grief, love, struggle, wonder, awakening — through short guided sits, contemplative questions, poetry, and music meditation.
No experience is needed and no particular belief is required. Whether you come from a church pew, a meditation cushion, or nowhere at all, each episode meets you inside your ordinary life — the commute, the kitchen, the sleepless night — and gently trains the mind toward presence, clarity, and calm. A few minutes a day is enough to settle the body, soften what is tight, and begin to transform the way you meet your life — and, by extension, the lives of everyone around you.
Press play, take a breath, and come sit. Whatever you are living through, this is your season.

title: CitasAlma

description:
CitasAlma is for people who'd rather send one thoughtful message than spend an evening scrolling — an online dating platform that puts soulful, intentional conversation at the center of how people connect.

Does being intentional mean being less safe? No. CitasAlma monitors continuously for suspicious activity and works to keep unwanted content away. Many users can be verified through a trusted third-party vendor, and reporting is always available for any behavior worth flagging.

What does daily use on CitasAlma actually look like? Browsing member profiles that feel worth reading, following a newsfeed, returning to saved message drafts before sending, using one-tap interest markers, following members, relying on icebreakers when the first message isn't coming easily, and filtering search results to find people worth investing a considered first message in. Photos can be shared in chat once a conversation has some soul behind it.

Support is reachable 24/7, with straightforward questions typically answered within a day and more complex ones resolved within a few business days.

Joining CitasAlma takes a free sign-up and a profile — nothing more elaborate than that. The platform lives on a mobile website, so there's nothing to install. Verification goes through an independent third-party process, but it's there for anyone who wants it before committing time to a conversation.

For people who think one real conversation is worth a hundred superficial ones — CitasAlma is built for that instinct.

title: Leading Disruption with Charlene Li
author: Charlene  Li
description:
When was the last time you did something at work that genuinely scared you?
Not "this meeting is uncomfortable" scared. I mean the kind where you didn't know if you were going to get it right. Where the ground felt unsteady. Where every smart, experienced part of you said, “This might not work.”
If you can remember that moment, you know exactly what leading disruption feels like.
If you can't, that's actually the more important signal.
I'm Charlene Li. I'm a strategist and author, and I've spent my career studying what it takes to lead through change. Not the comfortable type of change. We’re talking about real, disruptive change. The kind of change that creates entirely new value while destroying the old at the same time.
This podcast is called Leading Disruption. And it exists because disruption isn't coming; it's here. AI. Organizational change. The speed at which everything is moving. Leaders are being asked to operate in conditions they have never trained for.
Every week, I'm going to give you the frameworks, the honesty, and the real-world perspective you need, not just to survive what's ahead, but to lead it. On your terms.
We're going to talk about why your body is wired to avoid disruption and why running toward it anyway is the only move that works. We're going to get specific about AI: what the right questions are, why most leaders are asking the wrong ones, and what it takes to create real value rather than empty activity. And we're going to go beyond AI too, because disruption stay still. 
If your palms are a little sweaty and your stomach is churning, good. That means you're doing it right.
I'm Charlene Li. This is Leading Disruption.

Welcome to Night Time Spooks, your destination for chilling stories, creepy encounters, dark mysteries, and terrifying tales that are best experienced when the lights go out.

When the world becomes quiet and the night takes over, strange stories begin to emerge. Stories about mysterious figures seen in the darkness, unexplained sounds coming from empty places, encounters deep in the woods, abandoned buildings, strange creatures, haunted locations, and moments that leave people wondering what they really witnessed.

Here at Night Time Spooks, we explore the darker side of storytelling.

Our channel brings you scary stories, paranormal encounters, urban legends, creepypastas, mysterious disappearances, strange discoveries, supernatural experiences, and fictional horror stories designed to keep you watching until the very end.

Some stories may be inspired by alleged real-life encounters, eyewitness accounts, folklore, or internet mysteries. Others are fictional stories created purely for entertainment. Whatever the origin, each episode is designed to create an immersive atmosphere where suspense builds slowly and the unknown is never far away.

Imagine driving alone on an empty road at 2 AM.

You notice something standing beside the trees.

You look again.

It's gone.

Or perhaps you're staying in an old house when you hear footsteps coming from the floor above you—even though you know you're completely alone.

These are the kinds of moments that live inside Night Time Spooks.

🎧 Put on your headphones.

🌑 Turn off the lights.

🕯️ Find a quiet place.

And prepare yourself for stories that might make you look over your shoulder.

Whether you're a fan of horror stories, paranormal encounters, creepy pasta, supernatural mysteries, monsters, ghosts, unexplained phenomena, or dark storytelling, there is always something waiting for you here.

Subscribe to Night Time Spooks and join us as we explore the stories that are difficult to explain and even harder to forget.

Because once the lights go out...

the night has its own stories to tell.

👁️ NIGHT TIME SPOOKS
Dark stories. Strange encounters. Fear after midnight.

title: Right on Rangers LIVE!
author: Austin Beckman
description:
Right on Rangers is where Rangers fans ride the season in real time.

The LIVE shows are the heartbeat. Big wins, ugly losses, bullpen chaos, breakout heaters, trade rumors, roster debates, and the takes that come with actually caring about this team.

Sometimes those takes get hot. That’s part of watching 162 with people who are invested. But the reaction still has receipts. We use stats, film, history, roster context, and what’s happening on the field to figure out what the game actually revealed.

Between LIVE shows, we go deeper on the players, decisions, stories, and moments shaping Texas baseball.

Rangers first, always. When the calendar turns, the Cowboys, Longhorns, Mavericks, and the biggest Texas sports stories get their run too.

If you want sterile box-score recaps, this probably isn’t your show. If you want passionate Rangers talk with actual baseball underneath it, welcome in.

author: Megan · Big Mother Energy
description:
Hello friend — welcome to THE BIG DREAM HOTLINE, from Big Mother Energy.
This is the show for every mom who packed her dreams into a box marked "someday" and shoved it to the back of the closet. The bakery. The book. The business. The one-way ticket. The degree. We're getting the box back out.
Here's how it works: real moms call or text the hotline — (914) 340-4611 — and say their wildest dream out loud, some for the first time ever. Then host Megan plays it on the show, becomes the loudest person in their corner, finds the first step they can take THIS week, and dares them to take it. Deadlines included. Follow-ups guaranteed.
Because a dream that stays in your head isn't a plan — it's a secret. And you've been carrying yours long enough.
No dream too big. No dream too "silly." One rule: you have to say it out loud.
New episodes weekly. Bring your dream. 📞
Got a dream? Call or text the hotline: (914) 340-4611. (Messages may be played and lightly edited on the show.)
#BigDreamEnergy — Say it out loud, mama.

title: Coming Out of the Mist: protest, politics, and the provenance of the Urewera Triptych
author: Amanda
description: In June 1997, one of New Zealand's most famous paintings disappeared in the middle of the night - but the real story of this crime began over a century before. The theft of Colin McCahon's Urewera Triptych wasn't simply an art crime—it was also a political statement about generations of loss and delayed justice. Nearly three decades later, the painting's extraordinary journey continues to challenge our nation's beliefs on the rights of mana whenua iwi, and the ownership of taonga.

description:
Welcome to Heal With Justin, the podcast dedicated to helping you reverse chronic illness naturally using Medical Medium information and proven healing strategies that support your body's incredible ability to recover.

description:

description:
Emma is a high achieving, middle class girl from west London. She seems destined for a successful career in banking and a comfortable British life. Until she makes a decision that will come to define her. In 2001 Emma marries Bashar al-Assad - the now infamous dictator of Syria.


In the early days, people inside and out of Syria dared to hope. Alongside his beautiful, progressive wife, Bashar promised to modernise the country.


But when the Arab Spring reached Syria in 2011, Bashar's regime showed itself for what it really was: a brutal force, willing to capture and kill ordinary Syrians demanding change. And in all the years that a war raged on, Asma stands by her husband. She seemingly ignored the desperate pleas to stop her husband from killing his own people. 


But what did she really know about the atrocities her husband’s government was carrying out? And what choices did she really have? Some people allege that she actually assisted the regime and cashed in on the war, that she herself is a war criminal. Others say she tried to run away but was trapped, held hostage by a regime who threatened her life and her children. 


So, who is the real Emma?

title: Healthcare Confidence | Patient Advocacy, Caregiver, Terminal Illness, Diagnosis
author: Gabrielle Snedeker- Coach, Consultant, Advocate, Registered Nurse
description:
Are you in the middle of an emotionally complex, high-stakes healthcare crisis? Do you find yourself suddenly responsible for making decisions for someone you love or even yourself? 
Are you exhausted, overwhelmed, and have more questions than answers? Perhaps you’re faced with a new diagnosis and no one has explained what to expect, or maybe you’re hearing the words but struggling to process them through fear and uncertainty? You’re terrified of making the wrong decision for yourself or for your loved one? 
I’m so glad you’re here?
This podcast will help you process the medical realities that you are faced with, ask better questions, and navigate difficult decisions with greater clarity and confidence. Most importantly, I want to help you align healthcare decisions with the values and goals that matter most to you so you can breathe a little easier knowing that you and or your loved one remained at the center of every choice you made.
Hi, I’m Gabrielle, a registered nurse who has specialized in caring for medically complex patients and their families for over 25 years; including those in intensive care, oncology, emergency medicine and many places in between. I’m also a Christian, a mom, a granny, an animal lover and I am fueled by sunshine!
Over the years, I’ve witnessed the emotional turmoil, confusion, and uncertainty individuals and families face when making decisions for themselves or for the people they love; whether it’s navigating a serious illness, choosing treatment options, considering hospice care, or facing end-of-life decisions. These moments carry enormous weight.
My goal is to help you feel informed, supported and less alone during one of the hardest and most pivotal times of your life. 
I believe in having the hard conversations that no one wants to have because clarity creates confidence, and making informed decisions creates peace. 
I truly believe that I’ve been called to do this work and it is an absolute honor to walk alongside you.   
So grab some water, take a deep breath, and sit with me… You do not have to navigate this alone.

title: Ham In The Sandwich
author: Stella
description:
There is a stage in your career no one really prepares you for.You’re no longer junior enough to be guided, but not yet senior enough to control the game.You’re expected to deliver results, manage people, interpret strategy, navigate stakeholders, protect your team, satisfy leadership, keep growing — and somehow maintain a life outside work.That is the sandwich stage.Pressure from the top.
 Pressure from below.
 Expectations from every side.And somewhere in the middle is you.Welcome to H.I.T.S. — Ham in the Sandwich, The Diary of a Mid-Level Management Career Professional.In this introductory episode, Stella Uwaechue introduces the idea behind the diary and why this often-overlooked stage of professional life deserves a conversation of its own.We’ll explore what it means to:
  •  Manage up, sideways and down
  •  Navigate career transitions and pivots 
  •  Build relationships with mentors, sponsors and stakeholders 
  •  Stay relevant through learning and reinvention 
  •  Navigate workplace pressure and difficult environments 
  •  Balance career ambition with relationships, finances and life 
  •  Make sense of changing technology, AI and the future of work 
  •  Ask the harder questions about growth, identity, purpose and the seasons of life 
Some episodes will be practical.
Some will be reflective.
Some may challenge how you see your career.

But all of them will come back to one question:

What does it really take to navigate the middle well?If you’re somewhere between “I’m still figuring this out” and “Apparently, I’m supposed to have figured this out by now,” you’re in the right place.

Welcome to the sandwich stage.

🎙️ Next Episode: Managing Up — When Your Boss Thinks You Have Everything Under Control.

If you've ever felt caught between expectations from above, responsibilities below, and a life of your own happening in between — follow H.I.T.S.

New diary entries drop twice a week - Tuesdays & Thursday.Hosted by Stella Uwaechue

Work. Leadership. Life.

Welcome to the sandwich stage. 🥪

description:
Mapping North Deptford is an oral history and community storytelling project hoping to capture the lived experiences and local history that defines Evelyn, Deptford. Our first series is part of the 'What a Palava!' anniversary celebrations running this year at the Pepys Community Hub, marking the 60th anniversary of the Pepys Estate. By centering the voices of the people who live, work, and organize on and around the estate, the podcast will serve as both a celebration of the estate’s milestone anniversary and an archive of its community resilience. We want to archive these voices so that 10, 20 - 100 years from now, whoever is living and working in Evelyn can listen back and know who was here before them, what history surrounds them and what this community was up against in 2026.
Opening on the 18th of July 2026 with a special event, and running until the 18th of November 2026, as a participatory exhibition including photography, artwork, music and many more contributions from current and former residents. Pepys Community Hub asks what it means to document and remember this place today. title: How 40-Somethings Cultivate "Small Jobs" and Find Happiness
author: Hatchy
description:
This is my very interesting podcast"What was it I *really* wanted to do?"

This message is for you—someone in your 40s who commutes back and forth between work and home every day, fighting a lonely battle while feeling crushed by pressure and responsibility.


Welcome to the "Radio Show on Cultivating a 'Small Business' in Your 40s: Finding Happiness Without Chasing Big Money"!

This channel isn't about flashy success formulas like "Make a million yen a month!" or "Achieve FIRE in record time!"


It’s okay to earn just a modest income (or even not much at all). It’s about using your own time, turning your ideas into reality, and living life on your own terms. This radio show is dedicated to cultivating that kind of "personal small business" (a "stock business" that generates ongoing value).


🎧 【About the Host】

I used to work constantly on just five hours of sleep, eventually passing out on the last train home and being rushed to the hospital. In the moment I thought, "This is it—I'm dying," the faces of my family flashed before my eyes, triggering a major paradigm shift in my life.


After navigating six job changes through direct negotiation (without recruiters), experiencing freelance failure, and even returning to a part-time role, I am now a gym trainer in my 40s—living a real, relatable life while battling to pay off 1.3 million yen in debt.


I am by no means a "smooth" or polished success story.


Yet, by leveraging blogs, YouTube, and the latest technology (like AI) to create "digital alter egos" that work for me 24/7, I can confidently say that I am ten thousand times happier now than I was as a corporate employee—because I’m finally the one steering my own life.



🎙️ 【What to Expect from This Show】

I deliver "shared wisdom" that you can enjoy purely through audio—perfect for listening while commuting or doing housework. I use AI to make it easy for busy people like you to listen while multitasking.


By watching my raw, gritty struggle to reclaim my true self, I hope you’ll feel inspired to take a small step of your own. I want you to think, "If a clumsy guy like him can have fun doing this, maybe I could give it a try, too."

title: Perspective Matters Podcast
author: untanglingtogether
description:
It all starts here. 🤍

Welcome to Perspective Matters.

In this first episode, I'm introducing myself, sharing the story behind this podcast, and talking about why I believe mental health education should be accessible to everyone.

My mission is simple: to bring together science, real human experiences, and honest conversations that help us better understand ourselves, each other, and the world around us. Because when we understand why we think, feel, and behave the way we do, we create space for growth, empathy, and lasting change.

Whether you're here to learn, heal, grow, or simply become part of a community that values curiosity and transformation, I'm so grateful you're here.

This is just the beginning, and I can't wait to share this journey with you.

Because perspective matters. 🤍

description:
The Back to Health Podcast is about building a body—and a life—you can stay active in for the long haul.

Hosted by Dr. Tanya Westerbeek, chiropractor, mother and owner of Back to Health Chiropractic, each episode combines 20 years of patient care with honest stories about health, family, leadership, business and the beautifully unpredictable mess of real life.

You’ll hear practical conversations about why people wait to take care of themselves, what sustainable wellness actually requires, and how small choices compound over time. No perfection. No lectures. Just real stories, useful perspective and encouragement to take the next right step.

Because feeling better isn’t always the finish line. Sometimes it’s where the real work begins.

description: Storytelling never dies. Every guest is a creator on paper. On Decoded Stories, we decode who they actually are underneath that, the pivots, the setbacks, the moments that made them who they are, beyond the job title. I'm your host, Nyamekye Annor.

title: The Growth Desk | Leadership, AI & Marketing for Business Growth
author: GrowthAugment
description: The Growth Desk is about the people behind the growth. Each episode sits down with founders, operators, and executives at high-performing companies to trace the real arc of building one: how they've evolved as leaders, the pivots that reshaped the business, and the calls they'd make differently now. Along the way we get into what's working today, from AI search and visibility to marketing strategy, as buyers shift from search engines to answer engines. This is the interview arm of GrowthAugment's research newsroom, so expect real stories and data, without the generic advice you see everywhere else.

title: Breakthrough Gems
author: Nicole Grant
description:
Breakthrough Gems is where everyday life meets biblical truth.
Join Nicole Grant as we open the Bible and uncover the gems found in God’s Word, applying Scripture to the real questions, struggles, decisions, and circumstances we face every day.
From faith, healing, and salvation to identity, family, purpose, and learning to hear and trust God, each episode points us back to the truth of Scripture and the finished work of Jesus Christ.
You don’t have to figure life out on your own. God has given us His Word.
Let’s open it up.

We are two brothers who are lifelong fans of Disney, especially the Disney Parks stemming from a countless number of visits to Walt Disney World over the years. Regularly, you will hear the guys discuss the theme parks; news, events, stories, and other fun topics going on in and around the parks. At times, we will also branch off to discussions on Disney entertainment, mainly Walt Disney animation and Pixar, and much more. So, come along and listen to the podcast all about Disney.

title: Hear Me Out Podcast
author: Harold Chesney
description: Hear Me Out Is A Podcast Where Real Conversations Take Center Stage. We Dive Into Relationships, Dating, Mental Health, Personal Growth, And The Moments That Shape Who We Are. No Filters, No Fake Personas, Just Honest Perspectives, Meaningful Discussions, And Stories That Deserve To Be Heard. Whether You Agree Or Disagree, All We Ask Is One Thing… Hear Us Out.

title: The Future of Men Podcast with Troy Alexander
author: Troy Alexander
description:
The Future of Men is a monthly podcast exploring what it means to become a more whole, self-aware, and purposeful man through honest conversations about how we lead, love, fail, and become extraordinary people in today’s world. Hosted by Troy Alexander, founder of T363 Skin - each episode brings together remarkable people from business, sports, science, culture, and beyond to explore identity, leadership, relationships, purpose and personal transformation. I think rather than asking folks what they’ve accomplished, my show asks the deeper question, who did you have to become to get there?


We’re not here because we have the answers.

We’re here to ask better questions.

Welcome to The Future of Men.

title: Smoked
author: Aether Originals
description:
"There are stories that history tells, and then there are the stories that hide in the spaces between the words."

They said the fire took everything. They said the records were lost, the voices buried, and the truth turned to ash.

But what if the truth didn’t burn? What if it was just... smoked?

Smoked is an immersive, 20-episode speculative mystery audio drama from Aether Originals.

The series follows seasoned audio archivist and investigator Robert Bower, whose routine cleanup of a damaged recording uncovers a repeating, mathematical pulse buried deep beneath the analog hiss.

What starts as a simple job of separating signal from clutter quickly unravels into a coded roadmap—an "ember trail" of coordinates and timestamps leading to places the official maps tried to erase.

Bower learns that distortion is a form of camouflage, and the ambient static is actually a vault protecting a stolen past.

title: Rumor
author: FJ and DJ
description: Rumor: Dive deep into the mysteries, conspiracies, and unanswered questions of the world with hosts FJ and DJ. From urban legends to real life enigmas, we uncover the stories behind the whispers, challenge the unknown, and leave no rumor unexplored.

title: After TBI
author: Robert Hoover
description:
After TBI is a podcast about life after a traumatic brain injury — helping survivors bridge the gap between survival and rebuilding life. 
Hosted by trial attorney, Robert Hoover, this show is a resource for TBI survivors, caregivers, and families trying to navigate the overwhelming gap between diagnosis and the long road of recovery. Each episode features honest conversations with medical experts, rehabilitation providers, advocates, caregivers, and survivors who understand what it takes to move forward after a brain injury.
You’ll hear practical guidance on topics like treatment, recovery, daily functioning, long-term planning, legal navigation, and the invisible realities of living with a TBI. You’ll also hear real stories from people who have faced the fear, grief, disruption, and uncertainty of brain injury—and found ways to rebuild with strength, support, and purpose.
After TBI exists to help people feel less alone, better informed, and more equipped for what comes next. Because after a brain injury, survival is only the beginning.

description: Welcome to Patentlytics Podcast where patents meet strategy, data, and real-world impact. We break down IP trends, cases, and decisions that actually matter, giving attorneys, in-house counsel, and innovators clear, practical insights. No fluff, just sharp thinking on how patents are used, challenged, and leveraged today. If you want to stay ahead in IP, this is your edge.

title: Listen, They're Fine
author: Brandon (Bubba) Ogborn, John Ahern & Wyatt Gray
description:
Listen, They're Fine is the brutally honest parenting podcast for anyone tired of perfect families on social media. Hosts Bubba and John are best friends and neighbors with wildly different approaches to raising kids. Bubba's the chaos parent - wine mom energy, creative solutions, and yes, his 4-year-old knows some colorful language. John's the engineer dad with color-coded schedules, researched gear recommendations, and theories about everything.

Each week, they dive into the beautiful disaster of modern parenting - from navigating school politics to dealing with their own childhood trauma while trying not to mess up their kids. Expect heated debates about screen time, birthday party etiquette, and whether goldfish crackers count as a food group.

This isn't gentle parenting advice from certified experts. This is two regular dads figuring it out in real time, fighting like siblings, and giving you permission to be imperfect. Episodes drop weekly and feature everything from laugh-until-you-cry parenting fails to surprisingly deep conversations about breaking generational cycles.

Warning: Contains explicit language, discussions of mental health, and two grown men admitting they have no idea what they're doing.

title: Systems As A Way of Life Podcast
author: Thomas Nana Kwantwi
description:
Systems as a Way of Life

We live in an age of speed, noise, and surface-level answers.

Systems as a Way of Life is a reflective podcast for those who want to think more deeply about destiny, success, prosperity, leadership, and the philosophies that shape a meaningful life.


This is not motivational hype.
 It is structured reflection.


Each episode explores the invisible architecture behind visible outcomes, the patterns beneath performance, the systems beneath success, and the moral foundations beneath leadership.


Through calm, disciplined conversation, Thomas Nana Kwantwi unpacks timeless principles that govern growth, influence, and divine order.


If you’ve ever sensed that life is more interconnected than it appears 
 that outcomes don’t come from nowhere 
 that wisdom takes time 


You are in the right place.


Because life makes more sense when you learn to see the whole system.

Host Bailey Guilloud, a Somatic Intelligence Architect, guides listeners on how to build clarity, confidence, and emotional safety inside the body so success becomes sustainable. Through conversations, breakdowns, rituals, and nervous system education, Bailey guides listeners into deeper self-leadership, powerful identity shifts, and more authentic expression. Ideal for creators, entrepreneurs, and anyone ready to grow from regulation rather than pressure.

description: Value Creation Nation is a podcast for executives and business leaders navigating transformation in today's complex markets. Hosted by Gene Tyndall and Scott Moon, each episode explores the strategies, operational decisions, and leadership practices that drive measurable business value. From supply chain performance and AI to profitability, resilience, and execution, the show delivers practical insights to help leaders close the gap between strategy and results—and achieve profitable growth.

author: David Hutchins
description:
Sharing with you the amazing spiritual teachings I've learnt & what gave me the clear realisation to do this podcast, came from picking up the book becoming supernatural by DR Joe Dispenza. From his epiphany made me realise that I should start a podcast because I believe I too will have a positive impact on people's live by sharing my experiences, struggles, breakthroughs and the continued curiosity, wonder & unstoppable faith that gets me wanting to get up out of bed each morning, rather than dragging myself out of bed to ask myself what is life all about. title: Towards a Common Horizon
author: Hope, Hailey, Monica
description:
Welcome to our show, Towards a Common Horizon. We are the Montreal chapter of the national organization Common Horizon, where we are building a mass movement of everyday people. We come together to take power away from the billionaire class and win solutions to the climate crisis that secure good jobs, address affordability and ensure a dignified life for all. 

We have chapters across the country, in Victoria, Vancouver, Edmonton, Calgary, Montreal, and Toronto! Every two weeks, we’ll be here on Sundays at 8pm chatting about all things climate and affordability, connecting the dots between systems of inequality and climate collapse and shining light on solutions that can address the polycrises we face today.

title: SideCountry Podcast
author: SideCountry Network
description:
A podcast about the people, places and ideas shaping the British countryside.

Featuring voices from across the SideCountry network, each episode brings informed conversation, candid opinion and occasional disagreement to rural life in all its forms. Expect interviews and round-table discussions spanning conservation, farming, forestry, food, field sports, outdoor life, land management, culture and countryside policy.Serious when it needs to be, irreverent when it doesn’t, SideCountry looks beyond the familiar divides to explore how the countryside works, who it belongs to and what its future might hold.

SideCountry: https://sidecountry.co.uk/shows/sidecountry/

ABOUT THE SIDECOUNTRY NETWORK

SideCountry is an independent multimedia network for everyone who works in, on, lives in or simply loves the British countryside.Through podcasts, films, writing and more, it brings together people, stories, practical knowledge and informed opinion from across rural and outdoor life.

SideCountry covers everything from land management, conservation and countryside policy to food, farming, forestry, field sports, outdoor pursuits and rural culture.

title: I'm Just A Girl
author: Izzy Patterson
description:
I'm Just a Girl is the podcast for anyone who's ever thought, what the fck am I doing?


Your late twenties and early thirties can feel like life's biggest plot twist. One minute you're planning girls' holidays, the next you're being told it's time to buy a house, climb the career ladder, settle down and somehow have everything figured out.


Hosted by Izzy, this is a space for the conversations we're all craving but rarely having. Expect honest chats about life, confidence, friendships, careers, relationships, mindset and everything in between, plus guests who can help make sense of it all, from women a few steps ahead of you to experts breaking down the things nobody teaches us.


Because none of us really know what we're doing... we're just figuring it out together.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Join Peach, her gentle giant dog Presa, tiny black cat Pip, and their friends as they explore cottage life, nature, friendship and little adventures together.

You are kind. You are brave. You are loved.


Until our next adventure... 💛

title: Handbag Designer 101: The Stories Behind Handbag Designers, Brands, and Industry Icons

description:
Master the *handbag trends* , *fashion retail* , and *brand building fashion* strategies that define the *luxury goods industry*. From *fashion startup* founders to *fashion craftsmanship* experts, this podcast features exclusive *designer interviews* and insights into *iconic handbag history*.
Whether you’re an aspiring designer, a collector, or a *fashion executive* , join us to discover the business savvy and creativity required to succeed in the *handbag market*. Get the inside scoop on *leather goods manufacturing* , *fashion wholesale* , and the journeys of visionary creators.

title: Turn the Tables
author: Tranz Network Uganda
description:
Too many conversations about trans, intersex and gender-diverse people, including gender-nonconforming people, happen without them. Misinformation fills that silence; in homes, clinics, institutions, courtrooms and newsrooms.
Turn the Tables tears those misconceptions apart, in public, with evidence and lived experience.
Each episode brings a diverse panel to one table: trans, intersex and gender-diverse community members, including gender-nonconforming people, other LGBQ+ people, allies, health professionals, legal voices and sometimes the people who hold the misconception itself.

Health Starts With Her is an unfiltered, science-based talk show hosted by Dr. Tara Shirazian, created to help women cut through misinformation so they can feel more informed, confident, and in control of their health.

From the field to the future, we're turning dirt into data and data into decisions.

author: Cool Zone Media & iHeartPodcasts
description: Natural Causes is a podcast about the politics and practicalities of going outside in a world on fire, hosted by Dr. James Stout. It approaches the outdoors, conservation, agriculture, food sovereignty, and Indigenous land rights as interconnected issues. We want to combine unflinching journalism with unabashed advocacy for the land we all share, and welcome everyone into the outdoors and the fight for our public lands. description: My name is Tom, I'm truly delighted to be bringing you this podcast, recorded right here in Beijing. My hope is that literature lovers from all around the world will tune in and follow along. title: The AM Lift with Travis Hovel
author: Travis Hovel
description:
Are you ready to own your day before it owns you?


The AM Lift Show with Travis Hovel is your weekly blueprint for building a stronger body and a sharper, more disciplined mind. Every Wednesday, host Travis Hovel—a Physical Therapist Assistant and high-performance coach—bridges the gap between physical durability and mental toughness.


Through expert insights, guest interviews, and actionable strategies, we explore what it takes to master your morning routine, refine your movement, and build the resilience required for the modern human. Whether you’re looking to sharpen your focus, elevate your fitness, or simply find the motivation to attack your goals, this is the start to your day you’ve been looking for.


Elevate your morning. Elevate your life. 


Subscribe now to join the movement. New episodes every Wednesday.

title: The Golden Table
author: Jacob Chastain
description:
Education is everywhere. So why are we still talking about it like it only happens in a classroom?
The Golden Table is where education, culture, music, books, art, technology, philosophy, and the world around us collide.
Hosted by educator, author, and longtime podcaster Jacob Chastain, creator and host of Teach Me, Teacher, The Golden Table brings a decade of experience asking better questions—and takes those questions far beyond school.
What are we listening to? What are we reading? What are we becoming? And what does any of it have to do with how we learn, think, create, disagree, and live together?
Everything is connected. The Golden Table is where we talk about it.
Pull up a chair. Bring your curiosity. Stay for the conversation.

description: GSACEP represents emergency physicians who work in the federal government, including active duty military, National Guard, and military Reserves, as well as the Veteran’s Administration, Indian Health Service, and other federal agencies.This podcast series will feature selected lectures from the 2021 Government Services Symposium as well as conversations with leaders in military emergency medicine.Our mission is advancing emergency care for America’s heroes.  In this podcast, we bring you lectures and conversations with leaders in federal emergency medicine to help you better care for your patients and lead your departments.The views expressed on this podcast are personal views, and do not represent the views of the Department of Defense, any branch of the military, or the federal government, and they do not constitute endorsement of any product by any of these entities.

title: Highest Aspirations: A Religion and Human Rights Podcast
author: UNO Leonard & Shirley Goldstein Center for Human Rights
description:

-----

The Leonard and Shirley Goldstein Center for Human Rights at the University of Nebraska at Omaha (UNO) is a faculty-led unit in the College of Arts and Sciences designed to facilitate and catalyze increased human rights-related academic offerings, research, as well as local and international community outreach, partnerships and programming.

The Goldstein Center strives to be a nationally-recognized hub for scholarship on human rights, with a particular focus on religion and human rights, while supporting curriculum and pedagogical development at UNO and promoting community engagement and knowledge about human rights issues for a public audience.

title: Mindfully Her
author: Keshenae
description:
Mindfully Her is a safe place for your journey no matter what that journey may look like.
It is a space where women are heard, seen, and reminded that they don’t have to navigate life alone. While women are my primary audience, I recognize that mental health, healing, relationships, family, identity, and life’s struggles affect people of every gender and age. So while I intentionally center women, I make space for everyone. I don’t shy away from pain, struggle, uncomfortable conversations, or the complexities of life. But at the heart of Mindfully Her is hope, growth, healing, and understanding. This podcast is also a reflection of my own journey. I’m taking the time to share the people, experiences, lessons, and things that have helped me along the way. Through poetry, history, love, family, recipes, art, storytelling, laughter, and so much more, we explore the many pieces of life that can help us grow, heal, and better understand ourselves and one another. And I’m doing it all while parenting, working, loving, learning, and simply trying to live life. I come to this space with peace in mind, but I am not perfect and I don't pretend to be.

Some episodes, you’ll get Keshenae: reflective, vulnerable, thoughtful, and intentional. Other episodes, your host may be Nae-Nae the alter ego who brings a different energy, perspective, and maybe a little more unfiltered honesty. And that’s the beauty of Mindfully Her. It’s real. It’s unscripted. It’s straightforward. It’s human. There may not always be a perfect answer, but there will always be room for the conversation.

Welcome to Mindfully Her a place where we talk about life as it really is, find beauty in the messy parts, and remind ourselves that healing doesn’t have to look perfect to be real.

title: Regret Roulette

description:
Regret Roulette is the podcast where "nonsense" is the primary language and no topic is too random to tackle. Whether we’re spiraling into absurd "what-if" scenarios or roasting each other's questionable life choices, it’s a non-stop ride of laughs and loud opinions.

But it’s not all just fast talk and punchlines. In every episode, we spin the wheel on our own pasts to share the hilarious, cringeworthy, and surprisingly real regrets that made us who we are today.

It’s loud, it’s unfiltered, and it’s probably a mistake, but we don't regret a thing. New episodes drop bi-weekly!

title: Decoding Consciousness
author: Grace Denney & Hannah Sutherland
description:
Welcome to Decoding Consciousness.


What if reality isn't something that happens to you... but something you're creating?


Hosted by Sisters Grace Denney & Hannah Sutherland, Decoding Consciousness is a podcast exploring the mysteries of the mind, consciousness, and the nature of reality. 


Through honest conversations, personal experiences, and thought-provoking ideas, we dive into psychedelics, spirituality, neuroscience, healing, and the questions that most people are afraid to ask.

From dimensions, timelines, dreams, death, past lives, and altered states of consciousness to the science of the brain, the power of belief, and how our thoughts shape our lives... we're here to explore it all with curiosity and an open mind.


We believe your brain is like a computer, your beliefs are the code, and your reality is the output. By decoding the subconscious programming you've inherited throughout your life, you can begin to consciously create a reality that aligns with who you truly are.


Whether you're psychedelic-curious, deep into your spiritual journey, or simply fascinated by the biggest questions of existence, this podcast is an invitation to think differently, question everything, and discover what's possible when you begin decoding your own consciousness.


We’ll see you beyond the veil.
